points: Yirmiyahu answers Tzidkiyahu: I can't daven for the city. It will be burned. But you will survive and be taken to Bavel (and he is later blinded, like Shimshon).
Many Jews were held as slaves past the Torah's limit of seven years, because people sold themselves to pay debts.
Tzidkiyahu frees the slaves, likely also to keep them from joining the enemy, like the Romans and British did.
When the Babylonians leave to fight Egypt, the people feel safe and take their slaves back. That's a terrible crime.
Like after COVID or October 7th: we change when danger is near and slip back when it fades. We need to hold on to the inspiration.
